やることを待っています...

この会議について聞く

answers.q1: A meeting is being recorded and transcribed live. The title is '14:50 の会議', recording has just started (00:02 elapsed), and the app is listening but has not yet captured any speech.
answers.q2: That recording is active (red dot + 00:02 timer) and that the app is still listening with nothing transcribed yet - everything else on screen is an empty placeholder waiting for content.
answers.q3: I can pause or stop the recording from the floating black toolbar at the top, switch between 文字起こし/翻訳/字幕 tabs, type a question in the 'この会議について聞く' box at the bottom, or (once enabled) use リアルタイム要約/質問する/決定事項/アクション buttons.
answers.q4: Only partially. The red recording dot, running timer, and '聞いています...' text suggest it's active, but since the transcript, decisions, and to-dos are all still empty placeholders after 2 seconds, there's no actual output yet to confirm it is capturing anything correctly.
answers.q5: The four bottom-right action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) look greyed out/disabled and add visual clutter before there's any content to act on. The floating top toolbar with many small icons (pause, chat, expand, more, stop) also feels like an extra layer rather than part of the same surface.
answers.q6: The black floating pill toolbar at the top center - it has the strongest contrast (black against white) and sits detached above everything else, so it pulls focus before the red recording dot or the meeting title.

weaknesses.what: The black floating toolbar at the top reads as a separate overlay window rather than part of the same card/surface as the meeting panel below it.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the recording controls into the header of the main content card instead of a floating detached pill, so it visually belongs to one surface.

weaknesses.what: Four action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are shown disabled/greyed with no content to act on yet, adding visual weight without utility at this stage.
weaknesses.fix: Hide or fade these controls in until there is enough transcript content to make them meaningful, or replace with a single subtle 'available once discussion starts' hint.

weaknesses.what: There is no indication of which meeting platform or source this recording is coming from, and 'AI が見ている資料' does not show what material is actually referenced.
weaknesses.fix: Add a small source icon/label (e.g. Zoom/Meet/mic) near the meeting title, and make 'AI が見ている資料' expandable to preview the referenced document(s).
